attackers_goals: Disguise the email's origin by spoofing the received header to appear as a trusted sender, impersonating a trusted source, aims to mislead recipients into disclosing private data or performing unsafe acts.
description: This IP address has not been observed in correlation with the sender's fully qualified domain name within the last 30 days.
investigative_actions: Review the email's received headers, to trace its path and spot spoofing signs. Examine the sender's IP address and domain reputation. Closely inspect the email content for malicious links, attachments, or requests for sensitive information. Monitor further actions taken, such as file downloads or access to potentially malicious links.
